This is a quick post showing how to create a "Hello, World" example in FastAPI.

Similar to the example [*Hello World, In Flask*](https://galenseilis.github.io/blog/posts/hello-world-flask/index.html), with FastAPI we instantiate an app which contains methods that decorate other functions which will be used to returns responses. Finally, I used `uvicorn` to actually run the application at a given host and port.

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/")
def read_root():
    return {"message": "Hello, World!"}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import uvcorn
    uvicorn.run(app, host="127.0.0.1", port=8000)
```

That's all there is for this minimum working example.
